title: Three cheers for brewer | The Star
text:
Three cheers for brewer | The Star
HEINEKEN Malaysia Bhd has been recognised as “Company of the Year for Environmental Sustainability & Social Initiatives” by the Sustainability & CSR Malaysia Awards 2022 for the fifth year since 2017.
The company also received the “Long-Standing Excellence in Sustainability” award, in recognition of its sustainability commitment and consistent efforts in giving back to society through various initiatives.
